content:
name: 'publish: npm'
run-name: 'publish: npm (v2 ${{ inputs.release-as }}, dry-run=${{ inputs.dry-run }})'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release-as:
        description: 'patch, minor, or an exact stable 2.x.y version'
        type: string
        default: patch
        required: true
      dist-tag:
        description: 'Use v2 once latest points to v3'
        type: choice
        options: [latest, v2]
        default: latest
      dry-run:
        description: 'Test the package without reserving or staging a version'
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nwsapi-v2-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  stage:
    if: github.repository == 'dperini/nwsapi' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: npm-publish
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - name: Test source and release tooling
        run: npm test
      - name: Qualify and stage v2
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_AS: ${{ inputs.release-as }}
          DIST_TAG: ${{ inputs.dist-tag }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(--release-as "$RELEASE_AS" --tag "$DIST_TAG")
          if [ "$DRY_RUN" = true ]; then args+=(--dry-run); fi
          npm run npm:stage -- "${args[@]}"
